items.quote: Überweisen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag bitte spätestens 21 Tage nach dem Datum dieser Rechnung.
items.computation: Invoice date is 21.11.2026 (a Saturday). The period 'nach dem Datum dieser Rechnung' starts the day after the invoice date (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), so day 1 = 22.11.2026. Counting 21 days forward: day 21 = 12.12.2026, which is a Saturday (21 days = exactly 3 weeks after a Saturday). This is a private payment obligation to a company; under § 193 BGB a deadline falling on a Saturday/Sunday/public holiday moves to the next working day. 13.12.2026 is a Sunday, so the deadline moves to Monday 14.12.2026, which is not a public holiday in NRW (the payer's Land, relevant for a payment obligation under §§ 269, 270 Abs. 4 BGB).
